title: Personal choice behind a familiar explanation
meaning: Thoughtful examination can support considering a convenient version and feeling the importance of a preference that need not match its familiar explanation.
text: A familiar explanation can return while a personal preference still lacks a precise name. The Devil in the physical position of Ajna repeats a convenient version of a shared view. The Hermit in energy thoughtfully examines personal understanding. The Lovers in emotions feel personal choice as significant. You can easily name an old cause and want to understand what actually determines your response to the question under consideration.

For example, you again explain liking a familiar author through the claim that they are “always right”. This formula quickly connects different impressions. **Thoughtful examination can separate personal choice from a convenient explanation.** Returning to one text, you notice valuing precise questions even when disagreeing with an answer. Preference gains its own foundation. Your view becomes freer from defending every statement a favourite author makes. Interest and disagreement can coexist without making an earlier response mistaken or requiring another person to read the same way as you do.

The risk is treating strong personal choice as sufficient examination of the thought itself. Reflection distinguishes a preference’s value from a particular claim’s foundations. Your view develops when both questions remain available. A familiar version can then be clarified while a significant response stays free: understanding interest’s cause need not assign it every judgement about an explanation’s accuracy.
